blocks.text: Check our Miss International 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features Philippine bet Katrina Anne Johnson has emerged as one of the leading contenders for the Miss International 2026 pageant, according to a list curated by an established beauty pageant platform. Johnson placed second in beauty pageant portal Missosology’s Final Hot Picks released ahead of the competition’s final gala in Tokyo, Japan on Wednesday, Nov. 25. Johnson landed behind Peru, which topped the list, while the Dominican Republic completed the top three. India and Cambodia, meanwhile, placed fourth and fifth, respectively.
